Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communication Coordinator (Dutch-speaking) position at Herbalife. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and campaign coordination, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your local marketing efforts and support your distributor network.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has honed my project management and attention to detail. I have also coordinated social media integration and event logistics for my own project, mirook.com, demonstrating my ability to handle multiple tasks and collaborate with stakeholders.

I am native in Turkish, fluent in English, and have a B1 level in Dutch, with ongoing classes to improve. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable with hybrid work.

I am eager to bring my organizational skills and proactive mindset to Herbalife and help your campaigns succeed. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communication Coordinator (Dutch-speaking) position at Herbalife. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and campaign coordination, I am eager to contribute to your local marketing initiatives and support your distributor network.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress websites, which has sharpened my project management skills and attention to detail. I am comfortable coordinating with internal teams and external vendors to ensure timely delivery of assets, and I have experience creating templates, decks, and reports to track performance.

My project mirook.com has allowed me to take full ownership of a website from design to launch, including content creation, social media integration, and event promotion. This has strengthened my ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously, while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.

I am native in Turkish, fluent in English, and have a B1 level in Dutch, with ongoing classes to improve. I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am comfortable with hybrid work.

I am particularly drawn to Herbalife's mission of promoting healthy, active living and its people-focused culture. I am confident that my proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong organizational skills will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Herbalife's success.

Sincerely,
